items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And I remember when we played in Prague with the quartet with Joe Lovano.

ctx.x: George Mraz, yeah. George… he had a terrible experience when it, when it turned Communist. His, his folks had… I think his father was a doctor or something? And they had been just reduced to menial labor by the, when the Communists took over. So George somehow got a, got a gig in someplace and he packed everything up and he went there and never came back. He just came over to the States. Kinda the same way that Attila did. And I remember when we played in Prague with the quartet with Joe Lovano. Oh, let’s see, we…
That’s okay. You actually played a little bit with Attila from time to time, didn’t you?
